fact_refresh_unbound.description: A scheduling-layer selection document read a realistic instance fact key (fact_key, a resource. or inventory. key that recognition writes) for a candidate on the instance, and the value is unknown (unknown_reason), but no reader can refresh it (reader_problem, when known). Only that candidate is deferred, with no wake; it is evaluated again when the instance facts, the catalog or the configuration change. Other candidates and instances are unaffected.
fact_refresh_unbound.common_causes: The instance has never had the fact read, or its record expired, went stale for the document, lost confidence or has another type; the instance has no recognition maintenance package bound, or that package does not mark the key.
fact_refresh_unbound.handling: Run a task that reads the fact on that instance, or bind a recognition maintenance package that marks the key; the candidate is reconsidered once the fact is published.

fact_refresh_requested.description: The instance's recognition maintenance package is requested to read a realistic instance fact key (fact_key) that a candidate on the instance read as unknown (unknown_reason; rule_id, the selection document rule that read it, when one did). One entry per key, on the package's own scheduling decision and on its dispatch's reason chain; the package competes with the instance's other candidates under the highest rank of the candidates it unlocks.
fact_refresh_requested.common_causes: The key was never read on the instance, or its record expired, went stale, lost confidence or has another type, and the instance's bound recognition maintenance package marks it.
fact_refresh_requested.handling: None: the package runs as an ordinary scheduled dispatch and its readings are published as instance facts; the candidates that read the key are scored in the round after the reading lands.

fact_refresh_pending.description: A candidate on the instance waits for the instance's recognition maintenance package (package_id) to read a realistic key it read as unknown (fact_key, unknown_reason): the package is selected this round, or is held back for now by the gate gate_code (its minimum interval or failure backoff, an occupied, paused or unavailable instance, the host budget, a higher-ranked candidate, a Runtime admission gate), until next_eligible_unix_ms when known. failure_code is the code the package's latest run failed with, when it failed. The candidate is deferred, not failed.
fact_refresh_pending.common_causes: The instance fact is missing or out of date and the package is running now, or must wait for its interval, its failure backoff or its turn on the instance.
fact_refresh_pending.handling: None: the candidate is evaluated again when the reading lands, the gate lifts or the instance's key returns.

fact_refresh_unresolved.description: The instance's recognition maintenance package (package_id) ran successfully since the Runtime loaded the instance facts, and the key a candidate reads is still unknown because of it (fact_key, unknown_reason): the run gave no reading of the key (it did not reach the page that marks it, or the mark gave no reading), or the reading it gave had too little confidence or another type. The candidate is deferred until the package may run again (next_eligible_unix_ms).
fact_refresh_unresolved.common_causes: The package's route did not reach the marked page; the mark's region or OCR target does not match the screen; the recognition confidence is below the mark's floor or the document's.
fact_refresh_unresolved.handling: Check the package's reading marks and the task diagnostic's unresolved reading rows for the run; the package runs again after its minimum interval.

fact_refresh_exhausted.description: A limit (refresh_limit) holds back the instance's recognition maintenance package (package_id) that would read a key a candidate on the instance reads (fact_key): its daily limit is spent, its failed runs in a row reached the configured maximum today, the instance cannot place it, or the instance's activity window is closed or its activity budget spent (gate_code, the Runtime's admission code, when it gave one). The candidate is deferred until next_eligible_unix_ms when known.
fact_refresh_exhausted.common_causes: scheduling.fact_refresh.daily_limit or max_consecutive_failures is low for how often the instance's facts expire; the package keeps failing; the instance has no activity profile or is outside its activity windows.
fact_refresh_exhausted.handling: Raise the limit in scheduling.fact_refresh, fix the package's failures, or adjust the activity profile; the candidate is reconsidered when the limit's period ends.

selection_evaluation_aborted.description: Retired. A scheduling-layer selection document met an unknown input under an abort_evaluation clause, and the whole scheduling evaluation failed for every instance. Since 0.12.0 the scheduling layer defers only the candidate that read the input (fact_refresh_unbound or selection_input_unknown) and the round goes on.
selection_evaluation_aborted.common_causes: An instance fact the document reads was missing or expired on one instance while the document declared abort_evaluation for it.
selection_evaluation_aborted.handling: None in 0.12.0 and later: the code is no longer emitted. Before 0.12.0, refresh the fact or change the clause to drop_candidate.

selection_input_unknown.description: A gate or term (rule_id) of a scheduling-layer selection document met an unknown input (unknown_reason) for a candidate on the instance that no reading can supply: an instruction key or pack data no instruction supplied, a fixed field, or a lookup that covers no value. Only that candidate is deferred, with no wake; it is evaluated again when the instance facts or the catalog change. One entry is written per rule that met such an input.
selection_input_unknown.common_causes: An instruction key (session.) was never set for the instance; the document's lookup lacks an entry and a default for a value the candidate has; the document reads a field the candidate does not carry.
selection_input_unknown.handling: Supply the instruction for the instance, or fix the selection document (add the lookup entry or default, or read a field the scheduling layer provides) and approve the catalog again.

selection_unknown_clause_ignored.description: A gate or term (rule_id) of a scheduling-layer selection document declares a drop_candidate or substitute clause (unknown_clause) that the scheduling layer does not apply: there an unknown input defers the candidate that read it. The document's author meant something else than what runs. An abort_evaluation clause gives no warning.
selection_unknown_clause_ignored.common_causes: A selection document written for an in-task select step, where the clauses apply, is used as the scheduling-layer document.
selection_unknown_clause_ignored.handling: Expect the candidate to be deferred instead of dropped or scored with the substitute; to keep the clause's effect, use the document in a select step instead.

policy_evaluation_input_invalid.description: The scheduling evaluation refused its input: the catalog, facts or instance snapshot break a rule the evaluator checks.

policy_evaluation_fact_type_mismatch.description: The scheduling evaluation found a fact whose value has another type than the catalog declares.

policy_evaluation_numeric_overflow.description: The scheduling evaluation overflowed an integer while it computed a rank, a budget or a time.

score_overflow.description: The scheduling evaluation overflowed an integer while it computed a priority score.

selection_policy_invalid.description: The catalog's scheduling selection document could not be evaluated.

scope_without_instance.description: Scheduling decision reason: the task's scope covers no registered instance.

failure_retry_immediate.description: Scheduling decision reason: the task's last failure allows an immediate retry, so its trigger counts as true.

trigger_false.description: Scheduling decision reason: the task trigger evaluated to false for the instance.

trigger_unknown.description: Scheduling decision reason: the task trigger needs observations that are not available.

feedback_stop_true.description: Scheduling decision reason: the task's feedback stop predicate evaluated to true for the instance.

feedback_stop_unknown.description: Scheduling decision reason: the task's feedback stop predicate needs observations that are not available.

task_cooldown_active.description: Scheduling decision reason: the task's dispatch cooldown has not elapsed.

instance_already_selected.description: Scheduling decision reason: a higher-ranked task already owns the instance in this evaluation round.

heavy_scene_budget_deferred.description: Scheduling decision reason: higher-ranked dispatches consumed the host's heavy-scene concurrency budget.

host_budget_deferred.description: Scheduling decision reason: higher-ranked dispatches consumed the shared host budget.

placement_selected.description: Scheduling decision reason: the instance satisfies scope, capability, affinity and host budget, and the task is dispatched there.

rank_breakdown.description: Scheduling decision reason: the ranking terms of a dispatched task (decision record).

decision_record.description: Scheduling decision reason: the policy state and the candidates a dispatch decision compared (decision record). The record lists at most eight other candidates of the instance, each as decision_candidate_not_selected; omitted_why counts the candidates it does not list by why, and is left out when it lists them all. omitted_why is written since 0.12.5 (Workflow #411 A26).
decision_record.common_causes: A candidate of the instance was dispatched; every selected reason chain ends with its decision record.
decision_record.handling: Nothing to do. Read the listed candidates' why, and omitted_why for the others, to see why they did not run.

instance_unavailable.description: Scheduling decision or planning-lane reason: the instance is unavailable.

capability_missing.description: Scheduling decision reason: the instance does not provide the task's entry operation.

instance_override_disabled.description: Scheduling decision reason: the task is disabled by its instance override.

activity_profile_missing.description: Scheduling decision reason: no activity profile matches the instance.

heavy_scene_budget_exhausted.description: Scheduling decision reason: the host has no heavy-scene concurrency budget left.

host_capacity_insufficient.description: Scheduling decision reason: the host cannot satisfy the task's load profile.

score_deferred.description: Scheduling decision reason: the priority selection defers the candidate until a later evaluation.

score_promoted.description: Scheduling decision reason: the priority selection promotes the candidate.

score_aging_cap.description: Scheduling decision reason: the candidate's aging reached its cap and promotes it.

timeline_unavailable.description: Scheduling decision reason: a timeline event has no positive applicable interval.

timeline_active.description: Scheduling decision reason: a timeline event's interval is active.

clock_occurrence_expired.description: Scheduling decision reason (Workflow #361 R7): a clock predicate whose catalog sets missed {kind: skip_after, grace_ms} is not due, because its latest occurrence (occurrence_unix_ms) was not served before occurrence_unix_ms + grace_ms. The clock waits for its next occurrence; when it decides the trigger, the decision is trigger_false. The Runtime records the skipped occurrence once as clock_slot_expired.
clock_occurrence_expired.common_causes: The instance was busy, paused, held or refused by a budget until the occurrence's grace ran out, or no Runtime was running.
clock_occurrence_expired.handling: Nothing to repair: the catalog asked for the skip. Widen grace_ms in the catalog if the occurrence should still run later.

resource_targets.description: Scheduling decision reason: the resource targets that weigh the candidate under an active v2 policy.

resource_weights.description: Scheduling decision reason: the resource weights and term of the candidate under an active v2 policy.

resource_target_policy_ignored.description: Scheduling decision reason: a resource target record that the formal entry did not write is ignored.

resource_target_policy_unreadable.description: Scheduling decision reason: the instance's stored resource target policy cannot be read, and the instance runs base scheduling.

resource_target_policy_expired.description: Scheduling decision reason: the instance's resource target policy has expired.

resource_target_tasks_unevaluable.description: Scheduling decision reason: some tasks the resource target policy names cannot be evaluated.

resource_targets_parser_code_unexpected.description: The resource target document parser returned a diagnostic it never produces for that document.

resource_targets_canonical_encode_failed.description: A checked resource target document could not be encoded canonically.

resource_targets_view_encode_failed.description: A stored resource target could not be encoded for the resource target view.

malformed_rows.description: The stored resource target rows of an instance are malformed, so its policy is unreadable.

forward_projection_invalid.description: The forward projection or the predictive maintenance assessment refused its input.

forward_projection_overflow.description: The forward projection overflowed an integer.

step_budget_exhausted.description: Forward projection evidence gap: the evaluation step budget ran out before the horizon.

effect_evidence_insufficient.description: Forward projection evidence gap: a dispatched task's effects are only expected, inferred or not fully confident.

strategy_catalog_mismatch.description: A strategic report does not match the active catalog.

strategy_template_ambiguous.description: A strategic report's assessment matches more than one conditional template.

strategy_numeric_overflow.description: The strategic projection overflowed an integer.

execution_continues.description: Strategic planning-lane reason: execution continues under a matched template.

no_conditional_template_matched.description: Strategic planning-lane reason: no conditional template matched the assessment, so it needs planning.

pinned_observation_missing.description: Strategic planning-lane reason: a pinned observation is missing, so the instance needs detection.

catalog_too_large.description: Catalog compile diagnostic: the scheduling catalog's documents together exceed the catalog size bound.

unknown_field.description: Catalog compile diagnostic: a scheduling document carries a field its schema does not declare.

descriptor_mismatch.description: Catalog compile diagnostic: the scheduling documents of one catalog do not share one schema version and catalog descriptor.

predicate_unreachable.description: Catalog compile diagnostic: a task predicate cannot be satisfied as declared, for example an empty or unbounded boolean group.

predicate_uncomputable.description: Catalog compile diagnostic: a task predicate asks for a comparison the evaluator cannot compute for its input.

loop_budget_missing.description: Catalog compile diagnostic: a task's loop budget or runtime bound is missing or zero.

effect_incompatible.description: Catalog compile diagnostic: a task effect's direction or kind does not fit the pool it names.

approval_missing.description: Catalog compile diagnostic: the catalog declares no approval reference.

priority_selection_without_document.description: Catalog compile diagnostic: the catalog asks for priority selection but holds no selection document.

priority_selection_percentile_invalid.description: Catalog compile diagnostic: the priority selection's defer and promote percentiles are not declared together, are out of range, or are out of order.

feature_locked.description: A candidate is deferred because the active, unexpired session.feature. record fact_key of its instance is false and the task needs that feature; next_eligible_unix_ms is the record's expiry when it has one. A missing or expired record never defers (there is no substitute value).
feature_locked.common_causes: A run met the feature's locked page earlier; a person or an agent marked the feature locked.
feature_locked.handling: Nothing to repair. Publish true for the key once the feature is unlocked; otherwise the task is tried again when the record expires.

decision_reason_missing.description: A decision that is not selected ended without a reason, which is a programming error in the evaluator. The candidate is still deferred and the evaluation round goes on, so the gap is visible rather than reported as none.
decision_reason_missing.common_causes: An evaluator path that defers or blocks a candidate without pushing its reason.
decision_reason_missing.handling: Report it with the evaluation's inputs; the evaluator path needs its reason.

pack_schedule_closed.description: Every candidate of the task package package_id is deferred because the pack schedule that applies to the instance (an instruction row of session.pack.schedule, else a default row of the standard package) says the package is not schedulable now; next_eligible_unix_ms is the end of the covering row.
pack_schedule_closed.common_causes: A person or an agent closed the package for a period; the standard package closes it by default.
pack_schedule_closed.handling: Nothing to repair. Write a row that makes the package schedulable, or wait for the row to end.

pack_schedule_unknown_package.description: A session.pack.schedule row names a package that no task of the active catalog uses. Reported once per evaluation cycle; the row is kept and has no effect until a catalog uses the package. Not an error.
pack_schedule_unknown_package.common_causes: A row written for a package of another standard package or catalog generation.
pack_schedule_unknown_package.handling: Nothing to repair; remove the row if it is no longer wanted.

task_eligible.description: A scheduling candidate's trigger passed and its feedback stop did not fire: the task is eligible on the instance.

rank_assigned.description: A selected scheduling candidate's deterministic total score ranked it first on its instance.

score_computed.description: The score stage computed a scheduling candidate's effective score from its selection score, utility term, manual offset and applied resource target.

score_unknown.description: The selection document could not score a scheduling candidate because one of its gates rejected it (rule_id); only the utility term, the manual offset and any applied resource target apply.

score_cost_unknown.description: Neither a scheduling candidate's last run duration nor its declared expected duration is above zero, so its utility term is dropped.

decision_candidate_not_selected.description: A dispatch decision record lists another candidate of the same instance (task_id) that was not selected: why it did not run (the last reason of its decision, the one that settled it, never none), the state of its decision (decision_state) and its eligibility. The values why, decision_state and eligibility are written since 0.12.5 (Workflow #411 A26); the ranking terms of a ranked candidate stay developer text.
decision_candidate_not_selected.common_causes: The instance ran another candidate this round (why instance_already_selected), or a deferral or block settled this candidate (its own reason code as why).
decision_candidate_not_selected.handling: Nothing to do for the record itself. To find out why a task did not run, read why: it is the code of the condition that held the task back, and that code's own handling applies.

resource_target_unmapped.description: A resource target (resource_target_id) of the instance's resource-targets policy cannot be mapped to the candidate's task or resource.

resource_target_override.description: An override resource target (resource_target_id) supersedes the candidate's selection score and, unless it keeps it, its manual offset.

resource_target_pending.description: A resource target (resource_target_id) is configured but waits for a valid observation of its resource.

resource_target_satisfied.description: A resource target (resource_target_id) is met: its gap is closed and it no longer moves the candidate.

resource_target_applied.description: A resource target (resource_target_id) with an open gap is applied to the candidate's effective score.

fact_refresh_resolved.description: Workflow #384 D2-S5: the candidates of the instance no longer wait for the key (fact_key) they waited for: the latest policy cycle found it known, or no candidate reads it any more. Only a transition of the fact refresh recorder (an actingd daemon line, and from AO-4 a policy.fact_refresh_transition record), never a decision reason; package_id names the instance's recognition maintenance package when one served the key.
fact_refresh_resolved.common_causes: The instance's recognition maintenance package or another run read the key, or the catalog changed.

policy_remedy_waiting.description: Workflow #411 B15 (contracts/remedies.md): a task is held because its latest policy run on the instance ended on an outcome key (outcome_key) whose package declares a remedy for a need (need), and the remedy has not been served yet; the task is retried once after it. decision_id names the round (the blocked run's decision). The pair is deferred at position 8a of the order of deferrals with no wake of its own; gate_code and next_eligible_unix_ms say what holds the remedy's provider back, when known. For the clock-slot records it is a waiting gate.
policy_remedy_waiting.common_causes: The remedy's provider task is waiting for its own gate (budget, activity window, blackout, pacing, a held instance) or is running.
policy_remedy_waiting.handling: None; the hold ends when the remedy is served, when the round stops, or at the end of the activity window.

policy_remedy_requested.description: Workflow #411 B15 (contracts/remedies.md): a task is treated as triggered and past its cooldown and is promoted because its package provides a capability (capability) that a blocked task on the same instance needs; task_id names the blocked task, decision_id its round and outcome_key and need its blocked result. capabilities_allowed is the set the deciding source (remedy_source: the target record, the configuration or the package default) allows, capabilities_declared the remedy's declared set; remedy_depth is the chain layer (1 to 3); count is this request's number in the layer and limit_count scheduling.remedy.max_per_round; irreversible is true when a provider of the capability on the instance declares it so. One reason per blocked pair the dispatch serves, at most 16, in the provider's decision and dispatch chain.
policy_remedy_requested.common_causes: Another task's run ended on an outcome that declares this need, and the target record, the configuration or the package default allows this capability.

policy_remedy_retry.description: Workflow #411 B15 (contracts/remedies.md): a blocked task (task_id) is run again once, ahead of its trigger and cooldown and promoted, because the remedy it needed has run: capability names the capability whose provider served it, decision_id the round, outcome_key the blocked result and remedy_depth the layer; count and limit_count are the layer's requests used and scheduling.remedy.max_per_round. The retry is an ordinary policy dispatch; a retry that fails is an ordinary failure and closes the round.
policy_remedy_retry.common_causes: A provider task of the need's allowed capabilities succeeded after the block.

policy_remedy_unchosen.description: Workflow #411 B15 (contracts/remedies.md): a blocked task stopped and waits for a person: no source allows a usable remedy for its need (remedy_problem no_choice: no target record, configuration row or package default names it; choice_none: the deciding source says none; choice_invalid: the choice names a capability the remedy does not list or leaves nothing allowed; parameter_invalid: a chosen parameter value is not one of the provider's declared options). remedy_source names the deciding source and capability the capability concerned, when there is one. Written once per round as a goal_missed planning signal (signal:remedy:stopped:); the task stays deferred at position 8a, across windows and restarts, until remedy_inputs_digest changes or a person lifts it. Never the recovery ladder.
policy_remedy_unchosen.common_causes: No target record and no configuration row for the need and no package default; a target record written for older packages.
policy_remedy_unchosen.handling: Write the need's choice (actingctl remedy set, ac_remedy_set) or the configuration rows (scheduling.remedy.choices); or fix the game by hand and lift (actingctl remedy lift). Any change of the choices lifts the stop.

policy_remedy_unavailable.description: Workflow #411 B15 (contracts/remedies.md): a blocked task stopped and waits for a person: a remedy is allowed, but no task can serve it on this instance (remedy_problem capability_unbound: no catalog task on the instance is bound to a package that provides the capability; cycle: every provider lies on a refused cycle or is already in the chain; parameters_mismatch: the providers of the capability declare different parameters; provider_unavailable: every provider pair is paused, its package suspended, or it is disabled for the instance by an override or a placement refusal). Written once per round as a goal_missed planning signal (signal:remedy:stopped:); the task stays deferred at position 8a until remedy_inputs_digest changes or a person lifts it. Never the recovery ladder.
policy_remedy_unavailable.common_causes: The catalog has no task bound to a package that provides the capability; a provider package was unloaded or paused after repeated failures.
policy_remedy_unavailable.handling: Add or fix the provider task or package (the stop lifts when the declarations or the catalog change), or allow another capability.

policy_remedy_exhausted.description: Workflow #411 B15 (contracts/remedies.md): a blocked task stopped and waits for a person: its remedies ran as often as the round allows (remedy_problem round_limit: count reached limit_count, scheduling.remedy.max_per_round, in one layer) or the chain reached three layers (depth_limit: a provider at remedy_depth 3 ended blocked again), and the block remained. Written once per round as a goal_missed planning signal (signal:remedy:stopped:); the task stays deferred at position 8a until remedy_inputs_digest changes or a person lifts it. Never the recovery ladder.
policy_remedy_exhausted.common_causes: The remedy does not free enough; a provider is itself blocked by another need at the third layer.
policy_remedy_exhausted.handling: Look at the instance; change the choice or the packages, or fix it by hand and lift (actingctl remedy lift).

policy_remedy_lifted.description: Workflow #411 B15 (contracts/remedies.md): a stopped blocked task was released because the inputs of its remedy decision changed (remedy_inputs_digest differs from the stop's: a target record, the configuration rows, a package's remedy or provides declarations, the provider task set or the active catalog) or a person lifted it; it follows its own trigger rules again. Written once per round as a goal_missed planning signal (signal:remedy:lifted:).
policy_remedy_lifted.common_causes: A choice was written or lifted; the configuration, a package's declarations or the catalog changed.

policy_remedy_expired.description: Workflow #411 B15 (contracts/remedies.md): a remedy round ended with the activity window of its blocked run (window_end_unix_ms) before the remedy was served; the blocked task and its chain follow their own trigger rules again, and the next window's run opens a new round if the block remains. gate_code names the gate that held the provider back, when known. Written once per round as a goal_missed planning signal (signal:remedy:expired:).
policy_remedy_expired.common_causes: The provider stayed behind a budget, window, blackout or pacing gate until the window ended.
policy_remedy_expired.handling: None, if it is rare; otherwise widen the provider's window or budget.

policy_dispatch_parameters.description: Workflow #411 B15 (contracts/remedies.md, section 4): the read-only parameters this policy dispatch hands to its run: run_parameters holds one record per parameter the task's package declares, with the value resolved from the target record, the configuration or the package default and the source that gave it. The run reads each as the instance fact session.dispatch.parameter.<parameter_name> in its snapshots, an overlay that is never stored. Shared with Workflow #411 B8, which adds its own values to this reason.
policy_dispatch_parameters.common_causes: The task's package declares parameters (or a catalog opts in to Workflow #411 B8's values).
